svg.title: Short-range impurity rates change with the final-state density
svg.desc: In an isotropic 3D parabolic band with fixed mass, impurity density and constant Born amplitude, the final-state DOS and scattering rate are proportional to sqrt(K), while the relaxation time is proportional to one over sqrt(K). Curves start at K/Kref=0.1, not at zero. Kref=50 meV and tauref=0.67086 ps refer to the article's example.
